hypothesis: A distinct DATAGEN-only mode can produce OpenBench-v41-authenticated, role-partitioned, exact-count physical Crazyhouse chunks from complete live-search trajectories without changing the G0 fixture mode or normal play engine.
single_variable: add production physical self-play generation mode and its capability contract; keep playing search, G0 fixture behavior, evaluator, rules and physical wire unchanged

partition.campaign_ids_seed_and_partition_digest: must be frozen in a campaign addendum before generation

positive_matrix: production capability and OpenBench protocol identity
exact official book, selection policy, network and producer bytes
train and validation role filtering before search
selected MultiPV line owns its exact score and legal PV move
deterministic exact-subset quota with complete trajectories
G0 output regression and normal-engine command absence
negative_matrix: missing or wrong protocol, role, cohort or external workload identity
wrong campaign, partition seed, threshold, campaign-set or partition digest
missing, wrong-size, wrong-hash or incompatible network
missing, wrong-size, wrong-hash, duplicate-root or malformed book
missing or wrong producer or selection-policy hash
role mismatch, label-dependent selection or incomplete trajectory
bound or missing teacher line, illegal PV, safety exit or unreachable exact quota
preexisting output, partial collision, corruption or normal play artifact
stopping_rule: Stop on the first identity, role, partition, exact-count, complete-trajectory, teacher, physical-state, transaction, capability, G0-regression or normal-engine-isolation failure. Do not reinterpret fixture bytes as production data.
pass_effect: Qualify only the public production-capable producer implementation. A separately hash-frozen protocol-v41 two-role canary remains mandatory before any real dataset admission or larger campaign.
